title: SERAC memory value compression with shared Mirror basis
hypothesis: A shared rank-4 value code reduces explicit SERAC memory bytes while preserving held-out edit efficacy and scope locality; Mirror-specific value must beat native PCA coding and include retrieval/decode cost.
routing: Same nearest-key scope router and radius for all conditions; key vectors, thresholds and indices are paid in every payload.
storage: Actual serialized inference .npz bytes including base executor, keys, radii, values or code basis/codes, indices and schema.
success_gate: Both seeds: heldout nRMSE <=1e-5, positive hit >=99%, negative false positives <=1%, and payload <=50% explicit SERAC. Mirror-specific success additionally requires strict frontier gain over native PCA code at matched quality/routing.
failure_gate: Quality/scope/storage miss or exact native PCA alias. Fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: No training or tuning on fresh keys
